title.zh: 谷歌云故障导致多家银行服务中断
title.en: Google cloud outage takes down banks

current_state.zh: Google Cloud europe-west2 电力事件已缓解，但HSBC、Lloyds、Bank of Scotland、Revolut等银行及加密交易相关服务的中断和恢复情况仍在持续。
current_state.en: The Google Cloud europe-west2 power event has been mitigated, but disruption and recovery for HSBC, Lloyds, Bank of Scotland, Revolut and related crypto trading services are ongoing.

updates.title_zh: 谷歌云故障导致多家银行服务中断
updates.title_en: Google cloud outage takes down banks
updates.what_changed_zh: 谷歌云 europe-west2 区域发生电力事件，导致服务中断，影响了汇丰、Revolut、苏格兰银行、劳埃德、Equifax 等机构的网上银行和银行卡服务。
updates.what_changed_en: A Google Cloud europe-west2 power event caused an outage that disrupted online banking and card services for HSBC, Revolut, Bank of Scotland, Lloyds, Equifax and others.
updates.current_state_zh: 谷歌云 europe-west2 区域发生电力事件，导致服务中断，影响了汇丰、Revolut、苏格兰银行、劳埃德、Equifax 等机构的网上银行和银行卡服务。
updates.current_state_en: A Google Cloud europe-west2 power event caused an outage that disrupted online banking and card services for HSBC, Revolut, Bank of Scotland, Lloyds, Equifax and others.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A Google Cloud europe-west2 power event caused an outage that disrupted online banking and card services for HSBC, Revolut, Bank of Scotland, Lloyds, Equifax and others.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A Google Cloud europe-west2 power event caused an outage that disrupted online banking and card services for HSBC, Revolut, Bank of Scotland, Lloyds, Equifax and others.

updates.title_zh: 谷歌云故障导致 Revolut、劳埃德和汇丰服务中断
updates.title_en: Google Cloud outage takes down Revolut, Lloyds, and HSBC
updates.what_changed_zh: Google表示引发故障的电力事件已缓解，并建议受影响用户将工作负载迁移至其他可用区域；报道补充Revolut的加密交易、支付、ATM取款等服务受影响，Google Cloud状态页显示europe-west2区域出现 elevated errors 和间歇性网络故障。
updates.what_changed_en: Google said the power event behind the disruption had been mitigated and suggested affected users migrate workloads to another available zone or region; reports added that Revolut's crypto trading, payments, ATM withdrawals and other services were down, while Google Cloud's status page cited elevated errors and intermittent network failures in europe-west2.
updates.current_state_zh: Google Cloud europe-west2 电力事件已缓解，但HSBC、Lloyds、Bank of Scotland、Revolut等银行及加密交易相关服务的中断和恢复情况仍在持续。
updates.current_state_en: The Google Cloud europe-west2 power event has been mitigated, but disruption and recovery for HSBC, Lloyds, Bank of Scotland, Revolut and related crypto trading services are ongoing.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: A Google Cloud outage in London's europe-west2 region knocked out banking services at Revolut, Lloyds, HSBC, and Bank of Scotland, including Revolut's crypto trading and payment functions.
updates.detailed_summary_en: A Google Cloud outage in London's europe-west2 region knocked out banking services at Revolut, Lloyds, HSBC, and Bank of Scotland, including Revolut's crypto trading and payment functions.
